notes.title: UPDATE #1 is live!
notes.notes:
Good news!

Our first patch is already live for Windows, macOS & Linux, and that's in large part thanks to YOU. How come? That's because a big chunk of all the changes was based on your feedback! That's right, you helped us make the game better. Isn't that awesome?

Here's what we changed. BEWARE OF SPOILERS!
(We can’t avoid them due to the nature of the game.)

Are you ready?

Are you sure you want to see them?

Last chance…

Okay, here we go:

 Improved the conditions to unlock [spoiler]the grandfather's tribe[/spoiler].
 Fixed the dialogue line when going to [spoiler]look for Daniel[/spoiler].
 Fixed [spoiler]Anya's goodbye when she's antagonized toward the player[/spoiler].
 Transformation descriptions now appear also when calling the NEW_FORM() function.
 Edited the [spoiler]banner hanging[/spoiler] scene.
 Edited the [spoiler]unicorn[/spoiler] conversation.
 Increased the chance for [spoiler]Bartek to die during the hunt[/spoiler].
 Fixed the amount of Rage gained during the conversation with Olga.
 Fixed the function to calculate Honor.
 Various punctuation fixes.
 Edited the conversations about [spoiler]Kornel's former pack[/spoiler].
 Removed the unnecessary display of Rage during [spoiler]the visions[/spoiler].


Your opinion matters, so make sure to leave your review on Steam. Who knows, maybe one day you'll see a change that you suggested or inspired?

See you next time, wolves!
Piotr from Walkabout Games

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1342620/Werewolf_The_Apocalypse__Heart_of_the_Forest/

notes.title: Release date, price, and trailer!
notes.notes:
It's happening, Shapeshifters! We know all the release details for Werewolf: The Apocalypse – Heart of the Forest.

[previewyoutube=IwMxRFs8Tco;full][/previewyoutube]
Werewolf: The Apocalypse – Heart of the Forest will release on October 13, 2020, on Steam, for PC, Mac, and Linux. 

The price will be $14.99 / €12.49 / £11.39, and we will also have a special 10% release discount, available for 7 days after the release - so it'll be worth to grab it while it lasts. 

You can also wishlist the game on Steam to be notified about the release the minute it will be available.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1342620/Werewolf_The_Apocalypse__Heart_of_the_Forest/
But there's more!

If you wish, you will be able to get Heart of the Forest in the World of Darkness bundle, alongside Vampire: The Masquerade - Coteries of New York and Shadows of New York, with a special discount for the whole set, so stay tuned for more info about it.

When you answer the call of Gaia, make sure to review our game. It’s extremely important for every studio, especially a small one like ours.

Also, we’d love to know how your story turned out. Tell us your version of the adventure on Twitter, using the hashtag #WerewolfHOTF.
